caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object, specifically a pair of dark brown forceps or pliers, centered within a square frame. The tool has two elongated, curved handles that meet at a pivot near the top, where the two jaws or gripping ends are located; one jaw is slightly larger and more irregular than the other. The drawing uses shades of brown with some subtle gradations and shadows to depict the metallic surface and form, giving the object a three-dimensional appearance. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or details present. The drawing is bordered by a thin, hand-drawn square, and a signature is visible below the bottom right corner of the square.
title: Bullet Mold
